---
name: add-rule
description: Add a deterministic advisor rule with safety gates and complete tests.
disable-model-invocation: true
---
Add the requested rule. Define its evidence, formula, minimum window, coverage threshold, suppression conditions, reliability guardrails, confidence, severity, validation, and risks before coding. Include positive, negative, boundary, missing-data, low-coverage, stale-data, and conflicting-signal tests. Never create a dollar estimate without reconciled cost. Run `make verify`.
